summary: Transient keepalive suppression during multipath handoff mangles final payload and drops trailing tokens
description: Issue summary: Customer experiences consistent loss of the final paragraph or final fenced code blocks when a long-running SSE stream undergoes a network path change (mobile LTE -> Wi-Fi) and the connection experiences a brief keepalive silence. Impact: User-visible truncation of terminal tokens on ~20% of reconnects for streaming requests longer than 15s. Behavior appears correlated with multipath handoff and edge proxy connection reuse. Environment: Dedicated cluster in us-west, traffic routed via edge-proxy pool EP-5 behind customer-dedicated gateway.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Customer creates long streaming generation (prompt -> ~800 token target) using SSE in a mobile browser on LTE.
2) While stream is active, toggle network to Wi-Fi (path migration / NAT rebinding occurs).
3) Observe SSE reconnect sequence and final stream assembly in client.
observed_behavior: On ~1 in 5 reproductions the client receives the stream body up to the penultimate sentence, then either: (a) stream terminates without end_marker event and last fenced code block is truncated, or (b) a short heartbeat frame arrives but terminal JSON metadata isn't delivered, causing client SDK to treat stream as incomplete.
expected_behavior: Stream should resume/hand off without dropping terminal tokens or code fences; end_marker and terminal metadata must be present even after path migration.
logs_and_traces:
Edge proxy trace: conn_id=ep5-4a12, keepalive_gap=410ms, upstream-rebind=true
Serving runtime: request_id=req-8e3b, last_emit_ts=2026-03-12T18:23:14.921Z, final_emit_attempt=2026-03-12T18:23:15.332Z, client-cx-reset=true
Client SDK: sse_resume_request include resume_offset=781, seen_final=false
Note: keepalive frames at TCP level were suppressed (edge probe showed rapid RTT change).
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: brief suppression of keepalives during NAT rebinding causes intermediate proxies to treat connection as idle and atomically close write-side, leading to truncated final chunk before client rebinds.
SRE reproduced under controlled network emulator by simulating 350-500ms keepalive blackhole; observed identical truncated code-block in 3/10 runs.

Hypothesis refinement: when upstream rebind occurs and the edge reuses an existing backend connection, the serving runtime's final flush competes with proxy half-close. If proxy drops final FIN or truncates trailing window, client never receives closing array/token.
customer_comments: (BrightDocs) We're seeing this intermittently during demos and it's blocking our release. Happens mostly on iOS Safari and Android Chrome when folks switch Wi-Fi off/on.
(BrightDocs) We can provide a packet capture if needed — will send to support secure upload link.
internal_comments: Support (Aisha): Collected steps, sample request IDs, and replicated with customer in call. Escalating to SRE due to potential proxy interaction.
SRE (Marco): Reproduced in lab with netem. Filing INT-2109 to track proxy keepalive handling change and kernel socket TIME_WAIT behavior.
Eng (R&D): Noted related area in streaming flush path; adding a guard to emit final 'end_marker' before connection close handshake when feasible (see PR #7823).
mitigation_steps: 1) Short-term workaround: customer SDK can implement explicit periodic user-level heartbeats every 250ms to keep edge proxy from closing the write window during handoff.
2) For Dedicated customers: recommend edge-proxy config change to increase idle-tolerance during active SSE sessions from 200ms -> 800ms (ops ticket created).
3) Support can surface retry guidance: clients should request a resume with resume_offset and request a idempotent tail-fetch if final metadata missing.
resolution_plan: Medium-term fix scope: ensure serving runtime performs a best-effort synchronous finalization handshake (emit end_marker and metadata) prior to initiating any socket-level shutdown, and add defensive buffering at edge to forward terminal frames even during path migration. PR 7823 adds emit-before-close; ops change planned for edge pool EP-5. Target deploy: canary 2026-03-18 in us-west, full rollout 2026-03-22.
status_updates: 2026-03-12: Ticket created after initial customer call with reproducible examples.
2026-03-13: SRE reproduced locally using netem; INT-2109 opened to track proxy config investigation.
2026-03-14: Eng provided PR 7823 to add emit-before-close behavior; canary schedule proposed.
follow_up_actions: Monitor canary metrics for truncated_stream_count and server_emit_latency in us-west.
Add end-to-end test to CI that simulates NAT rebinding to catch regressions for streaming endpoints.
Update runbook 'stream-resume-troubleshooting' with guidance for SDK heartbeat frequency and resume_offset best practices.
